agent: G1 GIS reader (roads, rail, guideway, zoning, land use, parcels)
name: Wilkie D. Ferguson, Jr.
principle: Feature-level GIS tables for the reading agents. The agents read and interpret the features; code only clips, measures, joins and counts. The activity-density heat proxy and zoning are read together and are auxiliary evidence: neither decides demand, a station role or a configuration.
id_rule: cite object_id for features and fact_id (.Gnnn) for code-computed summary numbers; write no number that is not in this input
reference_point_note: GTFS reference point; not an entrance
parcel_privacy: no owner, mailing, site-address or legal-description field is requested or stored
parcel_table_rule: a parcel is listed individually when it lies in the inner band (within 660 ft), or its land-use group is one of listed_groups, or its lot is at least 20,000 sq ft; all other parcels appear only in the per-group summary; rows are ordered by distance and capped at max_rows
rail_split_rule: the county Railroads layer draws the Metromover guideway and the Metrorail line as rail without any attribute; trackage within 20 m of the GTFS Metromover shapes is reported as the existing guideway (facility to convert), trackage within 20 m of the Metrorail line as Metrorail, and only the remainder as other railroad trackage

rail.label: railroad trackage other than the Metromover guideway and the Metrorail line (county Railroads layer has no attributes; split geometrically, see config rail.split_rule)
Metrorail line (heavy rail, county MetroRail layer)

guideway.label: existing Metromover guideway (GTFS shape geometry, overlapping loops merged)
